title: CLI: hyphen-insensitive matcher and dotted sub-ID resolution (Rust + Python)
description: issue_identifier_matches (rust/src/ids.rs) and matches_issue_identifier (python/src/kanbus/ids.py) compare prefixes with hyphens stripped; remove reliance on the 6-char cap; dotted sub-IDs match base+suffix separately. Existing longer references (old 6-char) keep resolving.
